en:
You wanna talk again? You're pretty serious
about Neo-Aikido, aren't you, Shuichi?
<CLT=cltMIND>Not really, but...

Then, I'll teach you some pointers about
Neo-Aikido that you need to be careful about.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko's expression is unusually serious.

To tell you the truth, Neo-Aikido has a
certain weakness... And that's...
Yes...?

If you get too excited about Christmas or
Valentine's Day, your moves become weaker!
Ah...why is that?
Because Master said so!

That doesn't sound like
a very good reason.
It's an excellent reason!

<CLT=cltMIND>Did her master just
teach her nonsense?

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe he was teasing her.
Tenko is pretty gullible...

In my case, my moves become weaker if I
interact with males.

Also, if I eat more than three sweets a day,
or if I don't keep a clean environment...
<CLT=cltMIND>Okay, he was definitely teasing her.
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that the reason Tenko hates men?

I will master Neo-Aikido! That's why I can't
be touched by males!

Shuichi! No matter how friendly we get,
you must never touch me!

If you plan to walk the path of Neo-Aikido,
you must be prepared for this!

Isn't it impossible to live
without encountering any men?

Are you saying I can't master Neo-Aikido!?
Is this my limit!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Uh oh, shouldn't have said that...

Then I definitely can't forgive males! If I
rid them, then there'll be no more obstacles!

I already disliked degenerate males! But now,
I hate them with every fiber of my being!

It's how I feel when people think you can
simply blow the opponent away with Aikido!

The point of Aikido is to use your body!
Put your feet on the earth's ground everyday!

Unlike males who constantly stick their heads
in the clouds with their delusions!

W-Wait, Tenko!
Calm down a little...

Degenerate males' entire existence is
unforgivable! Inexcusable!

You better not underestimate me, okay!?
I may be physically weaker than males...

But Neo-Aikido isn't determined by strength,
but instead by how much you slack off!
<CLT=cltMIND>She's not listening at all...

In Neo-Aikido, you can use weapons!
You can even attack before the match starts!

Those are Master's teachings!
Now do you see how invincible it is!?
That doesn't sound like Aikido at all!

Also...isn't your master a man?
You've touched him, haven't you?
AAAAAHHHHHHHHH!!!!!

H-H-How could this be!?
You're right... Master is... Master is...
He's a degenerate male tooooooo!!!
You just now realized this!?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tenko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko screamed in panic, then settled
into a fugue state and walked away.

<CLT=cltMIND>After watching her leave,
I returned to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko looked really shaken up.
I wonder if she'll be okay...
